Oversight Board Meeting
AMENDED
AGENDA
OVERSIGHT BOARD TO THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
TO THE DISSOLVED COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK
Baldwin Park City Hall
14403 E. Pacific Avenue, Baldwin Park, California
Council Chamber
February 26, 2013
06:00pm
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:
The public may at this time address the members of the Oversight Board on any matters within the jurisdiction of the Oversight Board, prior to any action taker on the Agenda. No action may be taken on off-Agenda items except as authorized by law. Speakers are requested to limit their comments to no more than three minutes each.
This Agenda contains a brief general description of each item to be considered. Except as otherwise provided by law, no action or discussion shall be taken on any item not appearing in the following Agenda. Supporting documents, including staff reports, are available for review in the City Clerk's office. Oversight Board agendas/minutes are available at www.baldwinpark.com
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
BOARD MEMBER Manuel Lozano, Chair
BOARD MEMBER Evelyn Gutierrez, Vice Chair
BOARD MEMBER Mercedes Barba
BOARD MEMBER Juanita Gonzales
BOARD MEMBER Dr. Bill Scroggins
BOARD MEMBER Rose Tam
BOARD MEMBER Vacant
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
The public may at this time address the members of the Oversight Board on any matters within the jurisdiction of the Oversight Board, prior to any action taken on the Agenda. No action may be taken on off-Agenda items except as authorized by law. Speakers are requested to limit their comments to no more than three minutes each.
NEW BUSINESS
1.
APPROVAL OF OVERSIGHT BOARD MINUTES OF DECEMBER 18, 2012.
STAFF REPORT
2.
AFFIRMATION OF OVERSIGHT BOARD MEMBER SELECTION AND OVERSIGHT BOARD VICE-CHAIRPERSON VACANCY
STAFF REPORT
3.
RESOLUTION OB 2013-001 REGARDING APPROVAL OF CITY LOAN TO SUCCESSOR AGENCY FOR PAYMENT OF A PORTION OF FISCAL YEAR 2013-14 ENFORCEABLER OBLIGATIONS.
STAFF REPORT
4.
RESOLUTION OB 2013-002 REGARDING APPROVAL OF THE RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE (ROPS 13-14A) FOR THE PERIOD OF JULY 1, 2013 TO DECEMBER 31, 2013 AND ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGET FOR FY 2013-14.
STAFF REPORT
OVERSIGHT BOARD ITEMS
None
ADJOURNMENT
I, hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.
Alejandra Avila
Secretary to the Oversight board

NOTIFICATION 48 HOURS PRIOR TO THE MEETING WILL ENABLE THE CITY TO MAKE REASONABLE ARRANGEMENTS TO ASSURE ACCESSIBILITY TO THIS MEETING.
